title: Qualys API credential (data block)
description: The data block of a qualys_api_credential secret envelope (scope qualys): one Qualys subscription the read-only collector reads (req-qualys-connection). Least privilege: a Qualys user with the Reader role and the API Access permission only, with no UI access where the subscription allows it, scoped in Qualys to the asset groups or tags holding the in-scope AWS hosts. The collector only ever sends allowlisted reads: GETs, and one POST for the tag list, which Qualys offers in no GET form. The credential has no scannable shape, so the envelope layer, the leak guard and .gitignore are its protection.

api_host.description: The platform's API root, https only, from Qualys's platform identification page, such as https://qualysapi.qg2.apps.qualys.com. Host and scheme are lower-cased; a URL with userinfo, a path, a query or a fragment is refused before any request.

subscription.description: An operator-chosen label naming the subscription, such as acme-prod. Many subscriptions answer on one API host, so the host alone cannot identify one; the label and the host together key the subscription node.

username.description: The Qualys user name (Reader role, API Access). Sent only as HTTP Basic auth; never logged, never in a URL. It may not contain ':', which HTTP Basic uses to separate the user from the password.

password.description: The Qualys user's password. Sent only as HTTP Basic auth; never logged, never in a URL, never in any repr.

ca_bundle.description: Optional: the absolute path of a PEM CA bundle on the host for TLS verification, never its contents. Absent means the system trust store.

scope.description: Optional: the subscription's standing scope, sent server-side. At most one of asset_group_ids or tag_ids. A read made with it is a complete read of that scope; absent means everything the user can see.

asset_group_ids.description: Qualys asset group ids, sent as ag_ids.

tag_ids.description: Qualys tag ids, sent as use_tags=1&tag_set_by=id&tag_include_selector=any&tag_set_include=<ids>: a host matching any one tag.

sources.description: Optional: which kinds of Qualys data the collector reads for this subscription, each on unless set false. A source switched off is recorded on every run as not read, with the reason switched off, never as empty. At least one must be on.

detections.description: The host detection read (hosts and their detections, with the neutral findings, packages and EC2 links derived from them). Off: no host or detection is read or changed, nothing is withdrawn and the watermark stays. The probe still runs, because it is how the credential is checked.

knowledgebase.description: The knowledge-base read for the QIDs the detections name (title, severity, CVSS and the CVE list). Off: a QID the grid does not hold is written as a stub whose knowledge-base state is unobserved, and a finding that needs an unread CVE list is not moved to resolved.

tags.description: The subscription's asset tags, every tag the credential can see, from the Asset Management and Tagging tag search (req-qualys-tags). Off: no tag is read or changed and none is withdrawn.
